Job Summary 
The Full Stack Engineer will support the development and enhancement of scalable, cloud-native healthcare SaaS applications, with a primary focus on backend development, API integration, business logic, and healthcare data interoperability within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. The role will involve building reusable software components, developing data-driven applications, supporting healthcare interoperability standards, and working with Azure data and integration technologies to deliver reliable healthcare analytics and data exchange solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities 
•    Design, develop, and maintain backend services, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native applications. 
•    Build scalable and reusable software components that support multiple application modules. 
•    Develop and support healthcare interoperability solutions using standards such as FHIR and HL7. 
•    Develop and maintain business logic, transformation processes, and rules engines. 
•    Build and optimize data integrations using Azure technologies including Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Functions, and SQL Managed Instance. 
•    Support the exchange, retrieval, validation, and processing of healthcare and clinical data. 
•    Develop configurable and parameterized applications that promote scalability and reusability. 
•    Collaborate with Solution Architects, Product Leads, Scrum Masters, and engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions. 
•    Participate in Agile planning, sprint ceremonies, and technical design discussions. 
•    Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to continuous platform enhancements. 
•    Develop and support healthcare data integrations involving EMR/EHR, claims, pharmacy, provider, and interoperability data as applicable. 
 Required Qualifications 
•    3+ years of software engineering or application development experience. 
•    Strong proficiency in Python development. 
•    Experience developing RESTful APIs and backend services. 
•    Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure technologies. 
•    Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF). 
•    Experience with Databricks and modern data platforms. 
•    Strong SQL and database development skills. 
•    Experience with data modeling and business logic development. 
•    Understanding of cloud architecture and distributed systems. 
•    Experience working with healthcare data integrations, EMRs/EHRs, FHIR, EDI, claims, pharmacy data, or healthcare interoperability standards. 
•    Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
•    Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team. 
•    Strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
•    Experience implementing FHIR APIs and healthcare interoperability solutions. 
•    Experience with HL7 integrations. 
•    Experience with Health Information Exchange (HIE) solutions. 
•    Experience with Carequality and/or CommonWell frameworks. 
•    Experience integrating with EMR/EHR systems. 
•    Knowledge of CCDA clinical documents and healthcare data exchange. 
•    Experience with Django, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL. 
•    Experience within healthcare, pharmacy, payer, provider, or healthcare technology environments. 
•    Experience working with claims data, pharmacy data, or provider network data.
